text:
olivia (Support): customer opened a ticket after bumping SDK to 2.3.1, they hit a 400 on POST /v1/rerank. Pasting their payload and response below.

olivia (Support): customer error: "validation_error: candidates must be non-empty array of objects". They said it worked before the SDK upgrade. Payload they sent: 
```json
{
  "query": "Which feature should show for returning users?",
  "candidates": [],
  "top_k": 5
}
```

olivia (Support): they also included the SDK stack snippet showing serialization step (looks normal). Asking if this is an API change or client bug.

support-bot: api-gateway log: [1877789003] POST /v1/rerank 400 validation_error "candidates: must be non-empty array" client_id=acct-77 sdk_version=2.3.1 route=/v1/rerank

kevin (Eng): empty array is failing server-side validation. We started rejecting empty candidates to avoid wasteful rerank calls. Did the customer previously rely on server to expand candidates?

olivia (Support): they say older SDK behavior was to omit the field when there were no candidates, and the server used a default candidate set. New SDK explicitly sends an empty array.

ashley (SRE): note from ops: PR #1342 introduced stricter schema for rerank to ensure a no-op isn't charged. We didn't add an ergonomic error message. We should confirm gateway logs for exact raw body to rule out stringified arrays.

kevin (Eng): will repro locally. Quick curl test with the exact payload reproduces the 400.

olivia (Support): curl used for repro: 
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"Which feature","candidates":[],"top_k":5}'
```

kevin (Eng): root cause confirmed: SDK 2.3.1 changed default behavior to send an empty array when no candidates present. Server now rejects that. Proposal: two-track fix: update SDK to omit the field when empty, and augment server error payload to include field name + example.

ashley (SRE): agree on better error payload. Also want to add a lightweight metric to surface empty-candidates 400s over the next week to measure impact. I'll add a log parser rule.

olivia (Support): drafted reply to customer: 
"Thanks for the report. The rerank endpoint requires candidates to be a non-empty array of candidate objects. In SDK 2.3.1 we changed serialization so an empty candidates list is sent instead of omitting the field, which triggers a validation error. Quick fixes: either send at least one candidate object like {"id":"c1","text":"desc"}, or revert to SDK behavior that omits the field. Example payload: 
```json
{
  "query": "Which feature should surface?",
  "candidates": [{"id": "c1", "text": "Feature A description"}],
  "top_k": 3
}
```
If you prefer, share SDK logs and raw request body and we can check."

kevin (Eng): opening ENG-4057 to change error response to include "field" and "example" metadata and to coordinate with SDK team. I'll also add a small unit-test in retest harness for empty vs missing candidates.

ashley (SRE): filed log rule: LOG-796. Will report counts in daily ops digest. If we see a spike, we can consider temporary server-side compatibility that treats empty array as omitted (but prefer client fix).

olivia (Support): sending the customer the draft and flagging SDK team. Will keep this thread updated once customer replies. :thumbsup:
